description: Convert arbitrary text into a URL-safe slug (lowercase, hyphen-separated).
test_source:
defmodule TextTools.SlugifyTest do
  def run do
    StreamData.string(:printable, max_length: 40)
    |> Enum.take(200)
    |> Enum.each(fn s ->
      %{"slug" => slug} = TextTools.Slugify.run(%{"text" => s})
      true = slug == "" or Regex.match?(~r/\A[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\z/, slug)
      # idempotent: slugging an existing slug changes nothing
      %{"slug" => ^slug} = TextTools.Slugify.run(%{"text" => slug})
    end)

    %{"slug" => "hello-world"} = TextTools.Slugify.run(%{"text" => "  Hello, World!  "})
    :ok
  end
end
